parole.significato: A noisy celebration or party; also, an evening of traditional music and dance.
parole.testo: The etymology of sense 1 (“noisy celebration or party”) is unknown. Sense 2 (“strong wind”) is possibly from one of the following: * Borrowed from Orkney Scots hool(an) (“strong wind”) + English -ie (diminutive suffix). Hoolan is derived from Norn (unattested), from Old Norse ýlun (“howling, wailing
Borrowed from Scots cockaloorie, from Norn kokkeluri.
